items.text: I had a great virtual meeting with Alaskans from the H.O.P.E. Coalition in Sitka and the Ketchikan Wellness Coalition with @CADCA Alaska, who have been working diligently to prevent and reduce substance misuse in Alaska. https://t.co/yUIhynyUI6

Americans—& especially Alaskans—have been facing a one-sided Russian embargo on our seafood since 2014, harming our communities & economy. @SenDanSullivan & I are pushing Congress & the Biden Admin. to sanction Russian seafood, & equalize treatment of Alaska’s world-class seafood https://t.co/M0jLlnx5Ps

Under current @USCG policy, members may hesitate to seek needed mental health treatment for fear of a blanket discharge policy. My legislation will update policies, creating a more supportive environment by allowing those who protect our nation the opportunity to seek out help.

I was glad to stop by to say a few words at the Positive Leadership for Active Alaska Youth (PLAAY) Day 2022 in Anchorage—a synchronized event in which youth and adults in Alaska and across the country came together on zoom to take part in exercise activities. https://t.co/m8vrMxPqfC

Funding from the FY22 appropriations package is going directly to Alaskan communities like Skagway, who now have the funds needed to expand capacity at the wastewater treatment plant.  https://t.co/WbjZ63Vrld https://t.co/DDXSSRQNU6

Glad to join @covenanthouseak for their annual Sleep Out event—an organization that does so much to provide shelter & services to Alaska’s youth. As a long-time advocate, it was good to see Alaskans choosing to spend a night in the cold to show support for such a worthy cause. https://t.co/V01l4cP21q

I met w/ Alaskan advocates from @alzassociation. Alzheimer's is one of the most unforgiving & devastating diseases to witness—which is one of the reasons I’ve been supportive of the Comprehensive Care for Alzheimer’s Act, so we can work on research & treatment of this disease. https://t.co/WltavXGBV3
I am working with my colleagues in Congress to ensure babies in Alaska and across the country have access to the nutrition they need. https://t.co/U6sxqzBALp

Our nation’s veterans deserve the highest quality care and respect, and it’s our responsibility to uphold our commitments to honor their sacrifices—the PACT Act is one way of ensuring our veterans can access the care and treatment they need. https://t.co/iX3iqsuGq8

After experiencing flu like symptoms I recently tested positive for COVID-19. I will be following guidance and advice from doctors and will be quarantining at home in Alaska while continuing my work remotely.

Recently celebrated the completion of a new water treatment facility in Kotzebue. After visiting the old facility in April, it was exciting to be back in their community for their ribbon-cutting. There's nothing more fundamental to communities than clean drinking water. https://t.co/LbEhSMbwZP

@SenDanSullivan, @Rep_Peltola & I are urging @fema to approve @GovDunleavy’s request to waive the State’s cost share following Typhoon Merbok. This will go a long way in helping repair the storm’s damage to roads, water treatment plants, homes & more. https://t.co/NxxqwtSLhm

We heard testimony from community leaders about their Sleep Out event, where individuals spend a night outside in Alaska’s harsh winter to raise awareness for youth experiencing homelessness. I've taken part in the event on multiple occasions & it's truly life-changing.

I’m sorry to hear of my friend and colleague @SenBobCasey’s diagnosis, but happy to know he has an good prognosis and a positive outlook.

Wishing you and your family well, Bob.

The Broadband Grant Tax Treatment Act, of which I'm a proud cosponsor, will allow every dollar within our infrastructure act to be used for its intended purpose: ensuring that all Americans, no matter where they call home, have access to reliable, affordable broadband. https://t.co/17l2yZpTvF
By expanding ALS treatment research, we can make a real impact for the individuals and families who are affected by this disease.

We have a long way to go to achieve equality for women, and we need the #EqualRightsAmendment to get there.

Women should have equal treatment to men under the law & Congress should do all it can to ensure the ERA is finally made part of the Constitution—it is long overdue. https://t.co/7kAgYOVQVG

Two Army helicopters collided near Healy during a training exercise.

We lost three service members, and one is being treated for injuries.

My prayers are with them and their families.

Two bills I cosponsored to invest in Alzheimer’s treatment and research passed out of a HELP Committee markup this week.

Alzheimer’s is devastating and unforgiving, and I’ll continue to fight for treatment and prevention efforts to support people living with this disease.

When Jake Worthington was just 10 years old, his health was seriously threatened and he suffered long-term medical consequences after he was forced to go through step therapy, also known as “fail first” treatment. https://t.co/9r4Iu6hGPO

My heart is with the entire 11th Airborne Division and families of the soldiers who passed away during a training exercise outside of Salcha. Words can’t express my gratitude for their service and sacrifice. They will be sorely missed by so many.
https://t.co/zgbrcoIHbe

The bipartisan Nutrition CARE Act would help ensure that seniors and people living with disabilities who struggle with eating disorders have increased access to medical nutrition therapy—an effort that would make a difference in AL, where we face a shortage of treatment options.

Alaska Native leaders from the Cook Inlet region briefed congressional staff hosted by the Senate Committee on Indian Affairs to share how tribes, tribal organizations, and Native corporations exercise self-determination in Alaska. With the goal of protecting Cook Inlet land, people, salmon, and ways of life, these leaders provide housing, healthcare, and social services to up to 70,000 people in the region. I thank them for sharing how we work together in Alaska.

When people in crisis are ready to seek help, they shouldn’t be turned away because of workforce shortages. My legislation with @SenatorHassan will reduce barriers to training and education and help bolster our treatment and recovery services and greatly aid in the fight against the opioid epidemic. 
https://t.co/CpbJhs3Bjz

That’s why I’m proud to join my colleagues in supporting the TREATS Act, which makes the critical service of addiction treatment accessible by telehealth bringing the promise of recovery to every corner of our country.
